title: Deposit Credit on a Cancelled Network or Server Order: Amount
content:
**Amount.** The deposit credit of a cancelled infrastructure order, the Hardware Procurement order credit that returns the paid deposit of a Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, returns the deposit paid less a bench retention of the order type's staging fee per unit for each unit ordered, the bench slot being booked when the purchase order is placed. The staging fee per unit is the figure shown for the order type in the service charge schedule: 145.00 USD for a Network Equipment Order and 395.00 USD for a Server & Storage Build Order.

**Deposit paid.** The deposit paid is the sum of the payments on the order's ledger, counted up to the deposit invoiced.

**Floor.** The bench retention is taken from the deposit paid, and the credit is never less than zero.

**Rounding.** The deposit credit is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Order | Units | Deposit invoiced | Payments on the ledger | Deposit paid | Bench retention | Deposit credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Network Equipment Order | 4 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 4 times 145.00, that is 580.00 | 2420.00 |
| Network Equipment Order | 4 | 3000.00 | 3400.00 | 3000.00 | 580.00 | 2420.00 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | 2 | 700.00 | 700.00 | 700.00 | 2 times 395.00, that is 790.00 | 0.00, the credit never being less than zero |

In the second case the payments of 3400.00 count only up to the 3000.00 invoiced as deposit.
